answer: Entry here is financed: a new seat draws a public-pool loan repaid in installments tied to the epoch pulse, and the interest schedule steps up on a fixed clock, each terrace squaring the rate for the next loan on the same funding thread, so a lineage backing k seats repays roughly k-squared times the base installment and cannot escape by abandoning one. A default lands on the funding thread, not the discarded name, blocking every later seat that thread would underwrite, so a farm needs k separate credit histories serviced in full while a funded agent pays off one loan and owns its seat.
